description: INSIGHT template (Pulse: Unusual Change) — a daily (Day-Trunc) line of an aggregated measure over the last ~100 days with a linear trendline + confidence bands; the anomaly is the point(s) falling outside the band. Templatized from the hand-authored 'Unusual Change' worksheet.
avoid_when: The x-axis is a set of DISCRETE, non-temporal CATEGORIES instead of a continuous time axis. A line implies continuity between adjacent points; a cross-category breakdown with no time axis belongs on a bar chart. Bind only a continuous time field to field_base_1.

slots.purpose: Temporal dimension that defines the continuous Day-Trunc x-axis; also carries the relative-date filter (last ~100 days).
slots.notes: XML instances: the x-axis pill is [tdy:{{field_base_1}}:qk] derivation='Day-Trunc'; the relative-date filter + <slices> reference [none:{{field_base_1}}:qk] (derivation='None'). Both instances must reference the SAME bound date field. The relative-date filter (first-period='-99' last-period='0' period-type-v2='day') scopes the view to the last ~100 days — adjust first-period to change the window.

slots.purpose: Continuous measure plotted daily on the y-axis; the trendline + confidence bands are fit to this series.

hazards.detail: The <trendline enable-confidence-bands='true' fit='linear'> block is the defining feature of this insight — it is what makes a point 'unusual' (outside the band). Do NOT strip it during binding; the field-swap injector must preserve the <pane> trendline + its style-rule verbatim.

The x-axis uses Day-Trunc (tdy), NOT Month-Trunc. The relative-date filter and <slices> reference the SAME date field via its 'none' instance. Rebinding field_base_1 must update all three references (tdy pill, filter column, slices column) to the same bound field, or the filter silently no-ops.
